description: This Java source file defines the ApiProvider class, which manages caching and retrieval of various API instances (OcsAPI, NotesAPI, FilesAPI, ShareAPI) for the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It handles API instantiation, cache invalidation, and configuration of Gson serialization/deserialization, particularly for Calendar objects.

classes.name: ApiProvider
classes.description: Singleton class managing cached API instances for Nextcloud Notes Android client, providing methods to retrieve and invalidate APIs with custom Gson configuration.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ApiProvider.

methods.name: getOcsAPI
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an OcsAPI instance for the given SSO account, caching it for future use.

methods.name: getNotesAPI
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a NotesAPI instance for the given SSO account, considering the preferred API version.

methods.name: getFilesAPI
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a FilesAPI instance for the given SSO account.

methods.name: getShareAPI
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a ShareAPI instance for the given SSO account.

methods.name: getNextcloudAPI
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a NextcloudAPI instance for the given SSO account, configuring Gson with custom serializers/deserializers for Calendar and Capabilities.

methods.name: invalidateAPICache
methods.description: Invalidates the API cache for a specific SSO account, closing the API instance if it exists.

methods.name: invalidateAPICache
methods.description: Invalidates the entire API cache for all accounts, closing all API instances.
